Plain Signal: an AI magazine for everyone: sections, articles with photographs and their credits, a sub-editor and editor approval workflow, and a contact form drawn by an island.

Create it

mkdir plain-signal && cd plain-signal
bunx @crombolo/cli@latest init --template demo/plain-signal
bun install

Start it

bun start

The site is served on http://localhost:8080/.

The first start applies the template's content and publishes it. The back office is at http://localhost:8080/crombolo, and the start prints how to sign in (Getting started).

What is in it

  • a magazine about AI for everyone: sections, and articles with photographs and their credits;
  • an approval workflow, where a sub-editor and then an editor sign an article off before it is published;
  • a contact form drawn by an island, a part of the page that runs in the browser.

Where to look first

bunx crombolo workflows show articleApproval shows the sign-off, and components/shared/ holds the article list and the contact form island.
